name: structural_noise_prefilter
decision_policy: KEEP ambiguous content; DROP only when the typed protocol structure proves the item is mechanical orchestration with no task payload.

predicate.call_name: case-sensitive name in {wait, wait_agent, poll, sleep}
predicate.arguments: JSON object whose keys are a subset of {cell_id, duration_ms, max_tokens, poll_interval_ms, timeout_ms, yield_time_ms}
predicate.payload_exclusion: No argument key outside the mechanical wait-control set

rules.reason: The event is explicitly typed as a wait/poll operation and its arguments contain only scheduler/runtime wait controls, not task facts or result content.
illustrative_examples: function_call name=wait with cell_id and yield_time_ms
explicit_keep_cases: Any command/tool call named exec, bash, read, edit, test, or diagnostic
A wait-named call with a task-bearing or otherwise unknown argument key

predicate.payload: The typed output/content value is exactly null, the empty string, an empty list, or an empty object

rules.reason: The protocol declares a tool result but carries no payload at all; there is no content from which semantic evidence can be recovered.
explicit_keep_cases: A list containing any text/object part, even if it looks like a status wrapper
Any nonempty command result, diagnostic, stack trace, compiler/test output, or file content
An output event with a missing or unknown schema

predicate.linkage: call_id resolves to a preceding explicit_mechanical_wait_call
predicate.payload: After JSON parsing, the output/content is an object with exactly keys {message, timed_out}; message is a string and timed_out is boolean

rules.reason: The result is a typed wait protocol response with no task-state, diagnostic, code, or implementation payload beyond wait completion state.
explicit_keep_cases: Plain-text output from a wait call, because its contents are not structurally typed as wait-only
An object with any key beyond message and timed_out
A JSON object that is not linked to a typed wait call

global_non_matches: Do not drop based only on words such as stale, obsolete, failed, test, diagnostic, or running.

Do not drop code, source inspection, compiler/test output, diagnostics, stack traces, commands, file contents, implementation analysis, user instructions, assistant summaries, or coordination artifacts.
If a structural predicate cannot be evaluated exactly, KEEP.
hash_basis: SHA-256 of canonical JSON with sorted object keys and compact separators, excluding RULESET_HASH.txt and RULESET.md
